item.title: 【UPSCALED】Britney Spears - If You Seek Amy (1080p Upscale ProRes)
item.description:
​

Hello everyone! This time, I’ve upscaled Britney Spears’ If You Seek Amy! The source I used was the MASTER 512i, which wasn’t in the best condition, so I had to do a lot of fixing and adjustments to achieve a great result. I put a lot of effort into cleaning it up and enhancing the overall quality, and I’m really happy with how it turned out. As you can see from the screenshots I uploaded, it looks so much better now. Hope you enjoy it, and have a great day everyone!
